dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The primary 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters. There is a sharp gradient transition from low-intensity dark brown exterior pixels to high-intensity light grey interior bands. Perimeter geometry for the 4 most prominent structures is asymmetrical with varying edge thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the upper-right (anterior) section. These clusters appear as asymmetrical nodes with uniform high luminance and a lack of internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli located in the central dorsal region form a scalene triangle. The spatial relationship between the central-most 'O' structure and the 'C' structure immediately below it follows a near-vertical axis with a slight rightward tilt.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of deep, parallel transverse dermal folds is visible at the lower posterior extremity, characterized by high-contrast shadowing within the folds.
